description: List or search files. Optional query triggers semantic search. Supports section, tags, plan_status, limit, cursor filters.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous file_list response.

prompt_type.description: Filter prompts by type (only valid when section is "prompts").

query.description: Natural language search query. Omit to browse.

section.description: Filter by section. Omit to list all.

tags.description: Filter to files matching ALL of these tags.

name: file_list
title: List Files
